comparisonSources.role: Host compares exact metadata, stored identity, mounted/native/provider names and canonical argument digest; legacy provider derivation replaces invalid characters only.

UAR iterates Unicode scalar values, replaces non-ASCII-alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen with underscore, prefixes t when first character is not ASCII alphabetic, and for names longer than64 uses first51 sanitized characters plus underscore plus first6 SHA256 bytes of original UTF-8 name as12 lowercase hex characters.
